annotations.title: Search the Mode VC Investor Atlas

description: Searches the Mode VC Investor Atlas, a directory of venture capital firms and their partners compiled from public information (counts are in the response). Filter by firm or partner name, sector, entry stage, and headquarters or location. Stage and check size are as reported by each firm where available; it does not hold portfolio companies or fund performance.

query.description: Firm or partner name, e.g. "a16z", "Benchmark", "Marc Andreessen", "Khosla"

stage.description: Entry stage the firm reports investing at

name: search_investors
